Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **10.7 yd** downfield by the throw (n=282, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (62%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
